title: Payment Pattern Review
description: Review of unusual payment patterns: payments before sanction, same-day bursts, or oversized instalments.

steps.title: Identify the flagged payment(s)
steps.guidance: From the payment anomaly evidence, identify exactly which payments were flagged and why (before-sanction, burst, oversized relative to milestone weight).
steps.evidence_hint: Anomaly result values: payment ids, dates, amounts, rule triggered

steps.title: Review payment records against milestones
steps.guidance: Compare each flagged payment with the milestone schedule and completion records. Confirm whether the payment corresponds to certified work.
steps.evidence_hint: Milestone weights vs cumulative payment share

steps.title: Verify sanction timing
steps.guidance: For before-sanction flags, confirm the sanction date on record is correct and whether an earlier administrative approval exists.

steps.title: Record a conclusion with reasons
steps.guidance: State whether the payment pattern is explained by records or requires escalation. Data-entry errors (wrong dates) should be routed as data corrections.
